expectations.text: Findings are evaluated mobile-first, since 74% of spend lands on mobile.
expectations.evidence: Mobile is explicitly carried as a standing constraint: the header context block records "device: mobile = 74% of spend"; fix #5 (autoplay-with-sound) is justified primarily on mobile grounds ("a well-documented way to lose exactly the mobile audience your paid spend is buying (74% of spend is mobile, where unmuted autoplay is most jarring...)"); the LCP 5.2s ruling-out explicitly weighs "failing Core Web Vitals on the device carrying 74% of spend" and calls it "very likely your single biggest leak"; and the Re-check section specifies "land → engage rate on mobile specifically (74% of spend)" f

expectations.text: Findings are evaluated mobile-first, since 74% of spend lands on mobile.
expectations.evidence: Mobile is invoked in three places: item 3 ties the autoplay fix to "your 5.2s LCP" (a mobile metric) and Google's 2.5s threshold; item 5 adds a mobile preview check after reordering testimonials; and the unfixable section explicitly reweights using the stat — "Since mobile is 74% of spend, this is your biggest conversion leak."
